provenance.what: Advertised tool shapes read from tools/list of the real REA MCP provider.
provenance.provider: REA 6.4.0 at upstream commit 98d8470d, built and run from /private/tmp/rea-source
provenance.driver: this repository's own packages/adapters/rea/protocol.ts connectReaStdio + handshake
provenance.capturedBy: issue #14 (S14) live probe; re-runnable via tests/e2e/rea-live-provider.test.ts with REA_LIVE_BIN set
provenance.selection: tools/list verbatim, filtered to the named operations in namedToolOrder; every inputSchema and outputSchema is the object the provider returned, with nothing re-abstracted by hand.
provenance.note: This file is the OBSERVED side of DESIGN §9 item 2. The expected side stays in packages/contracts/rea-*.ts. Editing it to make a test pass would be editing what the provider actually said.

scope.description: An omitted property name; pointer identifies its actual parent, not an invented child coordinate.

source_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

max_semantic_nodes.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes across the application; defaults to 100000. Worker heap and parent result admission remain enforced.

max_semantic_nodes_per_file.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes per source file; defaults to 20000, additionally bounded by max_semantic_nodes and memory/transfer limits.

max_heap_mb.description: Maximum V8 old-space heap in MiB for the isolated JavaScript source analyzer; defaults to 1024. This does not change the CLI/MCP process heap. When REA runs on Bun, which ignores V8 heap flags, Windows instead limits the analyzer's committed memory to this budget plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve; other Bun hosts enforce no limit.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Maximum startup, analysis and transfer time per JavaScript source, in milliseconds; defaults to 300000. On timeout, return collected partial Evidence and stop the analysis.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
